svg.title: Evidence map: population group by direction of result, with overall risk of bias
svg.desc: Evidence map of 6 included studies by population group (rows) and direction of the between-group result as coded (columns, in order of first appearance in the file, not a scale: other, no between-group difference, favours exergame, mixed across subscales). One square per study, coloured and lettered by its overall risk-of-bias rating and labelled by first author and year. Cell counts: adults × other: 1 (Nikolova 2025 (oa-W7220097264) High †); adults × no between-group difference: 0; adults × favours exergame: 2 (Liu 2025 (pm-41307454) High, Anderson 2026 (pm-42974341) High); adults × mixed across subscales: 1 (Ngo 2026 (pm-41628428) Some concerns); older adults × other: 0; older adults × no between-group difference: 1 (Huang 2025 (pm-40567995) Some concerns); older adults × favours exergame: 0; older adults × mixed across subscales: 0; children and adolescents × other: 1 (Tunc 2026 (pm-43021294) High); children and adolescents × no between-group difference: 0; children and adolescents × favours exergame: 0; children and adolescents × mixed across subscales: 0. Overall risk of bias: 4 High, 2 Some concerns. † eligibility kept marked doubtful by the user: Nikolova 2025 (oa-W7220097264). Direction codes come from each trial's own between-group test and are not effect sizes. 'other' means the trial reported only a total or composite score of unstated construction or valence, so no direction is coded (amendment A11), and each such trial has at least one between-group test showing a difference; 'no between-group difference' is coded whatever the score's construction (amendment A14). Source: evidence-map.csv; record IDs are in its study_id column.
svg.text: Included studies by population group and direction of the between-group result
Direction (as coded; columns in order of first appearance in the file — the order is not a scale)
† eligibility kept marked doubtful by the user
(a) Direction codes come from each trial’s own between-group test; they are not effect sizes.
(b) “other”: the trial reported only a total or composite score whose construction or valence the paper does not state,
so no direction is coded (protocol amendment A11). Each such trial has at least one between-group test showing a difference.
(c) “no between-group difference” is coded whatever the construction of the score, because a null result needs no direction
(d) Source: evidence-map.csv, n = 6 studies; record IDs are in that file’s study_id column.
